## Session outcome

- Investigated operator-visible duration for `review-plan` and completion-verifier-gated close using logs, sidecars, ticket events, and the reusable `scripts/rebar_duration_probe.py` / `scripts/rebar_duration_probe_support.py` probe. Re-ran the analysis after excluding operations that made no LLM calls and corrected the measurement boundaries to cover the full operator wait rather than only narrow inner spans.
- The operator approved current expectations of 15 to 20 minutes for `review-plan` and 9 to 11 minutes for a completion-verifier-gated close, with no sample-size, legacy-tail, or uncertainty warning in agent guidance.
- Used the `rebar-debug` scientific-method workflow on the shared-store lock. PID 11145 was proven to be the intentional quiet-window barrier, not a stale or orphaned holder; behavior matched the documented bounded lock contract. The RCA and duration evidence live on `stalwart-allstar-jaguarundi` (`4000-2df3-398d-44e2`).
- Improved the performance-attribution direction to separate ticket snapshot work from workflow suboperations, and explored a cheap stable read-only ticket-store view for completion verification while normal mutations continue against the live store. The design work covered lock minimization, hierarchy and linked-ticket closure, unanticipated reads, parallel-review isolation, pinned `--ref` propagation, atomic sidecar/signature/status publication, and temporary-filename collision risks. Suspected pinned-ref and temporary-name issues were recorded as bugs requiring experimental verification before implementation.
- Added the approved one-line duration guidance to `AGENTS.md`. Gerrit change 2261 merged as `1ec658b88a7195c6e9d2b489f4e37137301fe2ce` with `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and zero unresolved comments.
- GitHub Actions run 33040949409 completed successfully in 1,460 seconds: 17 jobs succeeded, 2 were intentionally skipped, 0 failed, retry count 0, and no fixes were applied. Per operator direction, no manual local test suite was run.
- Closed `stalwart-allstar-jaguarundi` and then closed documentation story `lowcost-yokelish-jackal` (`6767-cc49-bf6f-4f22`) through a signed completion-verifier PASS. All five story acceptance criteria were checked.
- No `--force` command was used. The quiet-window prohibition was honored until the operator lifted it. The implementation worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/completion-read-view-experiments` was left clean and synchronized with `origin/main`; pre-existing untracked files in the shared main checkout were not touched.
- While creating this session log, rebar emitted `enrich drain gate check took 1954.4 ms (> 20 ms budget)`; this observation was not investigated in this session.
